English: Fire Altar
A simple stone platform for the sacred fire, offering basic spiritual focus and limited protection to the faithful.
Mud Brick Fire Sanctuary
A rudimentary mud-brick enclosure offers modest shelter for the holy fire, drawing more worshippers and fostering devotion.
Stone Fire Temple
A permanent stone structure housing the sacred flame, offering improved protection and a respected site for learning and ritual.
Decorated Fire Temple
An enhanced temple with symbolic carvings and painted walls, attracting pilgrims and increasing the temples renown.
Enclosed Fire Chamber
A secure, domed sanctuary protects the sacred fire from the elements and enhances spiritual authority, with dedicated priests overseeing rituals.
Sanctified Fire Sanctuary
A hallowed sanctuary, recognized for miraculous events, attracting scholars and pilgrims from afar. Its guardians are highly trained priests.
Ornate Fire Temple
An awe-inspiring, beautifully adorned temple with intricate tilework and gilded altars, serving as a center of learning and piety.
Grand Fire Temple
A magnificent temple complex with libraries and halls for great gatherings, it stands as a beacon of Zoroastrian faith and knowledge.
Blessed Fire Temple
A temple revered for its purest flame, with relics and sacred texts, its influence shapes the regions faith and scholarship.
Atash Behram
The highest grade of Zoroastrian temple, home to the holiest fire, a center of pilgrimage, learning, and spiritual defense revered throughout the world.
